Theme

Latin word

modus

modus, modī m.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

the amount, the measure of a thing; measure, limit (how far, how much); way, manner; a mood of the verb; in Quintilian also a voice; a style, a fashion; a tune, a melody (usually plural, modī); a measure

  • tune
